lines.en: I tap on Tsukasa’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Tsukasa 的名字,等她接听。

lines.en: : ...Hello?
And I hang up the second she does because I am better than this.
lines.zh: : 她一接,我立刻挂断——因为我比这强。

lines.en: Just because Tsubasa gave me her daughter’s number doesn’t mean I have to call her. And I’m not about to give into whatever subconscious temptation compelled me to do so.
lines.zh: : Tsubasa 把她女儿的号码给我,不代表我就得打给她。我更不会屈服于任何驱使我这么做的潜意识诱惑。

lines.en: She doesn’t need a tutor. And she definitely doesn’t need me as a tutor to top that off and put her in danger.
lines.zh: : 她不需要家教。而且她 absolutely 不需要「我」当家教——再来一层雪上加霜,把她置于危险之中。

lines.en: Which is what I am. Danger.
lines.zh: : 而那就是我。危险。

lines.en: To her. To myself. To her family. To everyone around me. And I’ve reluctantly accepted how that won’t ever change.
lines.zh: : 对她。对我自己。对她的家人。对我周围的所有人。我不情不愿地接受了:这一点永远不会改变。

lines.en: But just because I am completely, irreparably broken doesn’t mean I should drag someone else into this mess lest the cycle continues.
lines.zh: : 但正因为我自己已经彻底、无可挽回地坏了,我才更不该把别人拖进这摊烂事——免得循环继续。

lines.en: I slide my phone back into my pocket. She doesn’t need to know it was me that called.
lines.zh: : 我把手机塞回口袋。她不需要知道打电话的人是我。

lines.en: And I spend the rest of the afternoon thinking of how things could have gone wrong if I’d done something differently.
lines.zh: : 然后我用下午剩下的时间,反复推演:如果我当初做了不同的选择,事情会如何变糟。

lines.en: How they still could.
lines.zh: : 以及它们如今还能怎么变糟。

lines.en: And how I’ll be running from this part of me forever with a ghost who feels more like a shadow right there behind me.
lines.zh: : 还有,我将永远逃离这个部分的我——而那个像影子多过像幽灵的东西,就在我身后紧追不舍。

lines.en: Fragments of a thread get caught in your teeth and you spit them out onto the concrete.
lines.zh: : 线头的碎片卡进你的牙缝,你把它们吐到水泥地上。

lines.en: You are a disappointment and a failure.
lines.zh: : 你是个让人失望的失败者。

lines.en: : Hellooooo? You’ve reached the great and powerful Tsukasa Tsukioka. Speak now or I will have this number traced by my team of super hackers!
lines.zh: : 喂————?您已接通伟大而强大的 Tsukasa Tsukioka。现在开口,否则我会让我的超级黑客团队追查这个号码!

lines.en: : Hey.
: Jeeves? Is that you?
lines.zh: : Jeeves?是你吗?

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 算是吧。

lines.en: : How did you get my number? It’s supposed to be top secret. Even Nee-sama doesn’t have it.
lines.zh: : 你怎么有我号码的?那应该是绝密。连 Nee-sama 都没有。

lines.en: : But Chinami does?
lines.zh: : 可 Chinami 有?

lines.en: : Chinami is a business partner who I need to have important business conversations with. But you’re not a partner at all, Jeeves. You’re just a peasant. A peasant who steals phone numbers.
lines.zh: : Chinami 是需要和我进行重要商业谈判的商业伙伴。而你根本不是什么伙伴,Jeeves。你只是个平民。一个偷电话号码的平民。

lines.en: : Your mom gave it to me in the event that I decide to start tutoring again.
lines.zh: : 是你妈妈给我的——以防我决定重新开始做家教。

lines.en: : Hmm...I’m not sure if I trust you as a tutor anymore, Jeeves. Your methods seemed quite counterintuitive at our last meeting.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我不确定我还信不信你这个家教了,Jeeves。我们上次见面时,你的方法看起来 quite 违背直觉。

lines.en: : I wasn’t in the right frame of mind during our last meeting.
lines.zh: : 上次见面时,我的状态不太对。

lines.en: : Oh. Are you saying that you are in the right frame of mind today?
lines.zh: : 哦。你是说,你「今天」状态就对了?

lines.en: : No.
: Oh.

: In fact, I’m clearly insane for even calling you right now given how the conversation about doing this went with your mother. And you should hang up the phone immediately if you care at all about your future.
lines.zh: : 事实上,考虑到我和你妈妈谈「家教」的那次对话,我现在打给你简直就是疯了。你要是还有一点点在乎你的未来,就该立刻挂电话。

lines.en: : Everybody else is so boring, though. At least you’re entertaining in a pitiful sort of way.
lines.zh: : 可其他人都好无聊。至少你的可怜里,带着点乐趣。

lines.en: : I don’t need your pity, but I’ll accept it if I’ve already stooped this low.
lines.zh: : 我不需要你的怜悯——但如果我已经堕落至此,那就收下吧。

lines.en: : So, what do you want, Jeeves? Is it money? Or...have you done something unspeakable and you require my assistance disposing of the body? Or bodies. How many people have you killed?
lines.zh: : 那么,你想要什么,Jeeves?是钱?还是……你干了什么不可饶恕的事、需要我帮你处理尸体?或者尸体们。你杀了几个人?

lines.en: : I’d rather not talk about that.
lines.zh: : 那个我不想聊。

lines.en: : That many? I’ll send my best men right away. Never fear, Jeeves. Your secret is safe with me.
lines.zh: : 杀了那么多?我马上派我最好的手下过去。别怕,Jeeves。你的秘密在我这儿很安全。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...I just...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我只是……

lines.en: : I wanted to know if you’re...
lines.zh: : 我想知道你是不是……

lines.en: : If you’re free right now.
lines.zh: : 你现在是不是有空。

lines.en: : As in...you actually have decided to take me on as a pupil? Even while Nee-sama is currently going uneducated?
lines.zh: : 也就是说……你真的决定收我这个学生了?哪怕 Nee-sama 此刻还处于失学状态?

lines.en: : Touka’s in good hands with someone I trust to...do a much better job than I ever could.
lines.zh: : Touka 会有我信任的人照顾——那个人能做得比我好得多。

lines.en: : And while I haven’t exactly decided to start tutoring again...I think I need to meet with you and figure out if I’ll even be able to.
lines.zh: : 而虽然我还没完全决定重新做家教……我想我得见你一面,弄清我到底还能不能。

lines.en: : Ah! Yes, I’m quite familiar with interviews like this.
lines.zh: : 啊!好,我对这种「面试」非常熟悉。

lines.en: : Please come now so I can determine whether or not I will accept you as the man in charge of my education. But do know that I’ve made many a grown man cry during my interviews.
lines.zh: : 请马上过来,好让我判断,我要不要接受你作为掌管我教育的人。但请知道,我的面试里,已经让很多成年人哭了。

lines.en: : Oh, and dress nicely. You do want to make a good impression- don’t you, Jeeves? Especially if you are about to cry.
lines.zh: : 哦,还有,穿得体面点。你想留下好印象的——对吧,Jeeves?尤其如果你马上要哭的话。

lines.en: : This...isn’t really the type of meeting I had in mind considering you seemed more than willing to just hand me the job up until today.
lines.zh: : 这……不是我预想的那种会面——毕竟直到今天之前,你看起来都巴不得直接把这个职位塞给我。

lines.en: : I think this is plenty considering how badly you botched your first attempt at teaching me anything.
lines.zh: : 我认为这个待遇很充足了——鉴于你第一次试图教我任何东西时搞砸得有多惨。

lines.en: : Your interview starts in ten minutes! Tardiness will not be excused.
lines.zh: : 你的面试十分钟后开始!迟到不予原谅。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, I can’t teleport.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,我不会瞬移。

lines.en: : Wow. You peasants really do have it rough.
lines.zh: : 哇。你们平民过得真苦。

lines.en: : How about this, Jeeves? Close your eyes and think very hard about where you want to be.
lines.zh: : 那这样,Jeeves。闭上眼睛,用力去想你想去的地方。

lines.en: : Uhh...okay.
: Now what?
lines.zh: : 然后呢?

lines.en: : Open them, of course!
lines.zh: : 睁开眼睛,当然!

lines.en: : That’s not going to work.
lines.zh: : 那不会管用的。

lines.en: : You’re going to be a terrible tutor if you can’t listen to simple orders like this, Jeeves.
lines.zh: : 你要是连这种简单的指令都听不进去,你会是一个 terrible 的家教,Jeeves。

lines.en: : Tsukasa, that’s-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,那是——

lines.en: : Wait. How the fuck?
lines.zh: : 等等。他妈的怎么回事?

lines.en: : Behold the powers of ancient wizardry and infinite wealth! Now, bow down and kiss my foot, for you have entered my domain and must now do my bidding!
lines.zh: : 见证古老巫术与无穷财富的力量吧!现在,跪下亲吻我的脚——因为你已踏入我的领地,从此必须听我号令!

lines.en: : Yeah, I’m not going to do that.
lines.zh: : 是,我不打算那样做。

lines.en: : You are refusing my command?
lines.zh: : 你在抗命?

lines.en: : Yes. Now, tell me how you teleported me here.
lines.zh: : 是。现在,告诉我你是怎么把我传送过来的。

lines.en: : You teleported yourself here, Jeeves. With the help of your imagination. Anything is possible if you try hard and believe in yourself.
lines.zh: : 是你自己把你传送过来的,Jeeves。借助你的想象力。只要你努力并相信自己,一切皆有可能。

lines.en: : No...you did this.
lines.zh: : 不……是你干的。

lines.en: : Yes, you’re right. I suppose I did. But I’ll be keeping the source of my powers a secret until after we’re wed. Only then will I let you in on my ancient magic.
lines.zh: : 对,你说得对。大概是我。但我会对我的力量来源保密,直到我们成婚。到那时,我才会让你见识我的古老魔法。

lines.en: : This is one of the least believable situations I’ve ever found myself in and I can talk to animals.
lines.zh: : 这是我经历过的最难以置信的处境之一——而我还是个能和动物说话的人。

lines.en: : Perhaps you’re an ancient wizard too, then? I had a feeling you were concealing hidden powers, Jeeves. You’ve passed the first test. But now, you must defeat my four henchmen.
lines.zh: : 那说不定,你也是一位古老巫师?我有预感你在隐藏超能力,Jeeves。你通过了第一关。但现在,你必须击败我的四名手下。

lines.en: : You’re going to...make me fight the dudes standing behind you?
lines.zh: : 你要……让我和你身后站的那几个家伙打架?

lines.en: : Of course. It only makes sense for my tutor to be able to protect me. And you never know when you’ll have to fight off a swarm of bad guys who want to kidnap me for nefarious purposes.
lines.zh: : 当然。我的家教理应能保护我。而且你永远不知道什么时候,会有一群想绑架我的坏人从天而降。

lines.en: : No thanks.
lines.zh: : 不必了,谢谢。

lines.en: : Jeeves? What are you doing?
lines.zh: : Jeeves?你在干什么?

lines.en: : Teleporting myself back home. Anything is possible if you try hard and believe in yourself.
lines.zh: : 把我自己传送回家。只要你努力并相信自己,一切皆有可能。

lines.en: : Not so fast, commoner!
lines.zh: : 别跑那么快,平民!

lines.en: : I did not free up my extremely busy schedule to be toyed with by my interviewee.
lines.zh: : 我腾出我极其繁忙的日程,可不是来被面试对象耍着玩的。

lines.en: : And I didn’t swallow the last bit of my pride to come here and fight a bunch of silent, menacing guards.
lines.zh: : 而我吞下最后一丝自尊来到这里,也不是来和一群沉默的、面目可憎的守卫打架的。

lines.en: : What does your pride have to do with anything? You should be thankful to be in the presence of such power and influence. Most would jump at the chance to kiss my feet.
lines.zh: : 你的自尊和这有什么关系?你该感恩才对——能身处这样的权力与影响力面前。大多数人求之不得,想亲我的脚都排不上号。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, if I tell you what I meant by that, I’ll have to fight your henchmen whether I want to or not.
lines.zh: : 是嘛,我要是把这话说破,我就算不愿意也得和你的手下打了。

lines.en: : Now I’m confused. Are you here to kidnap me for nefarious purposes? Because it would be much easier for me to just give you whatever you’re in search of rather than ransoming me for it.
lines.zh: : 现在我糊涂了。你是来绑架我的吗?因为与其绑票,我直接把你想要的东西给你,要容易得多。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...I don’t know what I’m in search of. I don’t know why I’m here.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……我不知道我在找什么。我不知道我为什么来这里。

lines.en: : It could be confronting a part of myself I don’t want to face or...honestly, maybe just because I see promise in you or something.
lines.zh: : 可能是为了直面某个我不敢面对的自己。或者……说实话,也许只是因为我在你身上看到了某种潜质什么的。

lines.en: : Or hey, maybe I’m just so bad at socializing that I feel more comfortable around people who are still as mentally immature as you.
lines.zh: : 又或者,嘿,也许我只是太不擅长社交,以至于和「心智还像你一样不成熟」的人待在一起,反而更自在。

lines.en: : Are you insulting me, Jeeves?
lines.zh: : 你在侮辱我吗,Jeeves?

lines.en: : Not intentionally. But yeah, probably. To a certain extent.
lines.zh: : 不是故意的。但,对,大概有一点。某种程度。

lines.en: : I should teleport your innards across the Pacific Ocean to make you pay for such a thing.
lines.zh: : 我应该把你的内脏瞬移到太平洋对岸,让你为此付出代价。

lines.en: : Honestly, I’d probably prefer that over this.
lines.zh: : 说实话,比起这个,我可能还真宁愿那样。

lines.en: : You sure are weird, Jeeves. But it’s that weirdness that makes me want to hire you in the first place. And also the fact that it would make Nee-sama jealous.
lines.zh: : 你确实很怪,Jeeves。但正是这种怪,让我一开始就想雇你。还有,这会让 Nee-sama 嫉妒。

lines.en: : Interview complete! You’ve got the job!
lines.zh: : 面试通过!你得到这份工作了!

lines.en: : I don’t even know if I want it. Remember? That’s why I’m here in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不确定我想不想要它。记得吗?这正是我来这里的原因。

lines.en: : That’s why you came here! But now, you’re here for a different reason! To teach me things that many others have failed to teach me! While also keeping me entertained!
lines.zh: : 那是你来这儿的原因!而现在,你来这儿有了新的理由!教我那些别人都教不会我的东西!顺便让我保持开心!

lines.en: : But also, I’m legally obligated to inform you that you may be executed if you fail to live up to my expectations.
lines.zh: : 另外,从法律上我有义务通知你:如果你达不到我的期望,你可能会被处决。

lines.en: : Don’t tempt me with a good time.
lines.zh: : 别用好东西引诱我。

lines.en: : That’s the spirit, Jeeves! Nothing shows off that commoner mentality better than the acceptance that you may quite literally work yourself to death!
lines.zh: : 就是这种精神,Jeeves!没有什么比坦然接受「你可能真的会把自己工作到死」更能展现平民心态了!

lines.en: : Where are you going?
lines.zh: : 你要去哪?

lines.en: : To my nearest bedroom, of course! You don’t expect me to study outside, do you?
lines.zh: : 离我最近的卧室,当然!你不会指望我在外面学习吧?

lines.en: : Can we maybe go somewhere less private?
lines.zh: : 我们能不能去个不那么私密的地方?

lines.en: : But I’ll get distracted if others are present. A quiet environment is conducive to better learning. Even if I am already a genius.
lines.zh: : 可是有人在我会分心。安静的环境有助于更好地学习。哪怕我已经是天才。

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: : Silence, Jeeves! You’ve subjected yourself to my rule and must now do as I say or be forever banished from...everything!
lines.zh: : 安静,Jeeves!你已自愿接受我的统治,现在必须照我说的做,否则将被永久放逐出……一切!

lines.en: Tsukasa scurries off into the manor as three of her four henchmen stick right to her tail.
lines.zh: Tsukasa 急匆匆跑进公馆深处,四名手下中的三个紧紧贴着她的尾巴。

lines.en: The fourth one moves behind me and silently urges me to chase after her as best as I can.
lines.zh: : 第四个走到我身后,无声地催促我尽力跟上。

lines.en: He’s expressionless. Almost like a doll. And I don’t think it’s unwise of me to acknowledge that as a probability considering the family we’re dealing with right now.
lines.zh: : 他面无表情。几乎像个玩偶。而考虑到我们正在打交道的家族,我认为把这个当成一种可能性并不为过。

lines.en: In the several glances I’m able to spare over my shoulder, I don’t see him blink even once. But that makes me uncomfortable as I can’t tell what he’s thinking.
lines.zh: : 在我所能抽出的几次回头里,我一次都没看到他眨眼。这让我不舒服——因为我看不出他在想什么。

lines.en: I just know that if I were lucky enough to be wearing the shoes that he is, I wouldn’t be looking favorably upon me.
lines.zh: : 我只知道,如果我运气好到穿的是他那双鞋,我对我自己也不会有什么好脸色。

lines.en: And Tsukasa shouldn’t be doing that as well — but she’s so excited to peel off the wrapping paper covering Pandora’s box that she spares no skepticism whatsoever.
lines.zh: : 而 Tsukasa 也不该那样——但她太兴奋了,急着撕开裹住潘多拉魔盒的包装纸,一丝怀疑都省了。

lines.en: Then, before I know it, the two of us are locked inside a lion’s cage. But I’m the lion and she is the plucked and skinned carcass of a game-fowl.
lines.zh: : 然后,不知不觉,我们俩被锁进了狮笼。只不过狮子是我,而她是那只被拔了毛、剥了皮的野鸡。

lines.en: : Welcome to the den of ultimate knowledge! Where countless fools have perished at the hands of Tsukasa Tsukioka and her...ultimate knowledge!
lines.zh: : 欢迎来到终极知识之巢!无数蠢人在这里丧命于 Tsukasa Tsukioka 和她的……终极知识之手!

lines.en: : Your bedroom is two stories?...
lines.zh: : 你的卧室是两层?……

lines.en: : This one is. But I’ve been collecting them since I was old enough to walk and will one day inherit all of Nee-sama’s as well. And she has one that’s five stories tall.
lines.zh: : 这间是。但我从会走路起就在收集,总有一天会连 Nee-sama 的全部继承。她有一间五层的。

lines.en: : That seems...completely unnecessary. And you should probably let your sister keep at least one bedroom.
lines.zh: : 那……完全没必要吧。而且你大概该让你姐姐至少留一间卧室。

lines.en: : Why? She doesn’t even sleep here anymore. She’s always with her weird friend who likes chairs too much.
lines.zh: : 为什么?她都不在这里睡了。她整天和那个「太爱椅子」的怪朋友待在一起。

lines.en: : Ah. I see you’ve met Yasu, then.
lines.zh: : 啊。看来你见过 Yasu 了。

lines.en: : Come, Jeeves! Look over here!
lines.zh: : 来,Jeeves!看这边!

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: : This way, this way!
lines.zh: : 这边这边!

lines.en: I follow Tsukasa to the other side of the room, prompting her henchmen to follow us. But instead of feeling intimidated by their presence, I’m just thankful they’re here.
lines.zh: : 我跟着 Tsukasa 走向房间另一侧,她的手下也跟着我们。但面对他们的存在,我并不觉得受威胁,反而有点感激他们在这里。

lines.en: I doubt I’d do anything. At least...not purposely. But it’s good knowing that there’s a failsafe in place in the event that my mind decides to go haywire again.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑我什么都不会做。至少……不会故意的。但知道万一我的脑子再次失控,还有一道保险在,是件好事。

lines.en: Plus, it’ll allow me to keep my thoughts in order and actually be able to teach for once.
lines.zh: : 再说了,这也能让我把思绪管住,让我终于真的能教一次课。

lines.en: I still know how to do that, right?
lines.zh: : 我还记得怎么教,对吧?

lines.en: Wait, what am I even supposed to be teaching her?
lines.zh: : 等等,我到底该教她什么?

lines.en: : Isn’t the view from here amazing, Jeeves? I bet the one from your tiny, peasant apartment isn’t even close.
lines.zh: : 从这里看出去的景色是不是 amazing,Jeeves?我打赌你那间小小的平民公寓,连边都够不上。

lines.en: : I have a house, you know.
lines.zh: : 我有房子,你知道吧。

lines.en: : Sorry. You’re just so low on the totem pole that I normally imagine you sleeping inside of a large cardboard box.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你在食物链上实在太低了,我一般想象你睡在一个大纸箱里。

lines.en: : Hey! Do you want to see something cool?!
lines.zh: : 嘿!想看点酷的吗?!

lines.en: : You’re not going to take me to your sister’s five-story bedroom next, are you? This one is...more than sufficient for your first lesson.
lines.zh: : 你接下来不会要带我去你姐姐的五层卧室吧?这一间……作为第一课已经绰绰有余。

lines.en: : Oh, no. We don’t have to leave. I just wanted to show you a cool trick that Mother taught me. Watch.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。我们不用出去。我只是想给你看一个妈妈教我的酷招数。看着。

lines.en: : Was something supposed to-
lines.zh: : 刚才是应该发生什么——

lines.en: : Cool, right?
lines.zh: : 酷吧?

lines.en: : My servants have taken a vow of silence and can only communicate through hand gestures. Which is kind of like me knowing a second language when you stop and think about it.
lines.zh: : 我的仆人们发过沉默誓,只能用手势交流。停下来想想的话,这有点像我多会了一门外语。

lines.en: : I’m still way behind the many languages that Mother knows. But I’m almost guaranteed to catch up at this rate. Don’t you think?
lines.zh: : 我离妈妈会的那么多门语言,还有很大差距。但照这个速度,我几乎必然能追上。你不觉得吗?

lines.en: : Sure. Now show me the hand gesture that brings them back inside.
lines.zh: : 行。现在,把「请他们回屋」的手势给我看看。

lines.en: : Why? Won’t it be easier for the two of us to study in private?
lines.zh: : 为什么?我们俩私下学习不是更方便吗?

lines.en: : I’d just feel a lot more comfortable if they sat in and watched.
lines.zh: : 有他们坐在旁边看,我才会自在得多。

lines.en: : Well, I wouldn’t. I get nervous and uncomfortable when I have to do things in front of other people.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我不会。要在别人面前做事,我会紧张、难受。

lines.en: : You didn’t have any problems sitting in on my class and I have way more students than you have henchmen.
lines.zh: : 你旁听我的课的时候可没有任何问题,而且我的学生比你的手下多多了。

lines.en: : I have 143 henchmen.
lines.zh: : 我有 143 个手下。

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么要这么多?

lines.en: : Because seven of them “quit.”
lines.zh: : 因为之前有七个「辞职」了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa-
lines.zh: : Tsukasa——

lines.en: : Do you not want to be alone with me, Jeeves? Is it because I annoyed you when we were alone in your office?
lines.zh: : 你不想和我单独相处吗,Jeeves?是因为在你办公室单独相处时,我惹你烦了吗?

lines.en: : It’s not that...
lines.zh: : 不是那个……

lines.en: : I promise to be good. I really do want to learn. And if I do anything to annoy you, all you have to do is raise your right hand and I’ll stop talking until you say it’s okay again.
lines.zh: : 我保证乖。我是真心想学。我要是做了任何惹你烦的事,你只要举起右手,我就会闭嘴,直到你说可以为止。

lines.en: : Race you upstairs!
lines.zh: : 比赛谁先跑上楼!

lines.en: : Please don’t...
lines.zh: : 求你别……

lines.en: : But that’s where all of my notebooks are!
lines.zh: : 可我所有的笔记本都在楼上!

lines.en: : Then bring them down here...
lines.zh: : 那就把它们搬下来……

lines.en: : But I want you to meet my friends! Come on, come on!
lines.zh: : 可我要你见见我的朋友们!来嘛来嘛!

lines.en: I give into her excitement when I know I shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 明知不该,我还是向她的兴奋投降了。

lines.en: I follow her up the stairs when I know I shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 明知不该,我还是跟着她上了楼。

lines.en: And I sit beside her on the bed when I know I shouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 明知不该,我还是在她床边坐下了。

lines.en: : The cat is named Trixie. The bear is named Barry. The chicken is named Super Sonic Jalapeno Meltdown Catastrophe Nine-
lines.zh: : 猫叫 Trixie。熊叫 Barry。鸡叫超级音速辣椒熔毁灾难九号——

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么?

lines.en: : And the whale is named Franklin!
lines.zh: : 鲸鱼叫 Franklin!

lines.en: : Cool, right?
lines.zh: : 很酷吧?

lines.en: : ...Yeah. Yeah, they’re all really cool.
lines.zh: : ……是。是,它们都真的很酷。

lines.en: : So, what are we going to study today? Physics? Astronomy?
lines.zh: : 那么,我们今天学什么?物理?天文?

lines.en: : Are those really the topics you want to study?
lines.zh: : 这些真是你想学的科目?

lines.en: : I don’t really know. I’ve always had to follow a very strict regimen when it comes to my education. Mother says it’s the best way to properly exercise one’s brain.
lines.zh: : 我不太清楚。在我的教育上,我向来必须遵循非常严格的规程。妈妈说,那是正确锻炼大脑的最佳方式。

lines.en: : What I’m unsure of is how that regimen differs from that of the common man. But I imagine it’s quite a bit based on the gap in knowledge between Chinami and me.
lines.zh: : 我不确定的是:那套规程和平民百姓的有什么不同。但鉴于 Chinami 和我之间的知识鸿沟,我猜差距相当大。

lines.en: : Yeah. It is. And, to be completely honest, I don’t know anything about physics.
lines.zh: : 对。是挺大。而且,完全坦诚地说,物理我一点不懂。

lines.en: : Astronomy then?
lines.zh: : 那天文呢?

lines.en: : Astronomy...makes me uncomfortable.
lines.zh: : 天文……让我不舒服。

lines.en: : Because of the black holes?
lines.zh: : 因为黑洞?

lines.en: : Sure. Let’s go with that.
lines.zh: : 行。就这么算。

lines.en: : Well, what topics are you interested in, Jeeves? There must be something considering your history in teaching, right?
lines.zh: : 那,你对什么话题感兴趣,Jeeves?以你的教学履历,总该有点什么吧?

lines.en: : It’d be literature if anything.
lines.zh: : 真要选的话,是文学。

lines.en: : Then, do you want to talk about that book you mentioned the other day? The Catcher in the Rye?
lines.zh: : 那你要不要聊聊你前几天提到的那本书?《麦田里的守望者》?

lines.en: : You...
: You read it?
lines.zh: : 你读了?

lines.en: : I didn’t have anything else to do when you left Chinami’s room. So I read the whole thing while she watched a strange television sponge.
lines.zh: : 你离开 Chinami 房间之后,我无所事事。所以趁她看一块奇怪的电视海绵,我把整本读完了。

lines.en: : I particularly enjoyed the juxtaposition of the protagonist’s idealism with cynicism as it created an interesting dichotomy that paralleled how I often feel as an adventurous girl who must always obey the rules.
lines.zh: : 我尤其欣赏主角的理想主义与愤世嫉俗之间的并置——它营造出一种有趣的二元对立,与我自己常有感受遥相呼应:一个爱冒险的女孩,却必须永远服从规则。

lines.en: : You read the entire book in one sitting and came up with all of that by yourself?
lines.zh: : 你一口气读完整本书,还自己想出了这一切?

lines.en: : Did I misunderstand something? Was Holden Caulfield’s idealism naught more than a vessel to showcase hypocrisy in a believable, yet self-aggrandizing way?
lines.zh: : 是我误解了什么吗?难道 Holden Caulfield 的理想主义,不过是一个 vessel——用来以一种可信、却又自我吹捧的方式,展示伪善?

lines.en: : Jeeves?
lines.zh: : Jeeves?

lines.en: : Akira?
lines.zh: : Akira?

lines.en: : It’s “Sensei” while we’re here, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 在这里要叫「Sensei」,Noriko。

lines.en: : Do I really have to call you that? It feels super weird after calling you by your actual name for years.
lines.zh: : 我真的必须那样叫吗?叫了你几年真名之后,这样叫 super 怪。

lines.en: : Just while we’re tutoring, okay? Now, tell me — what else did you find interesting about last night’s reading?
lines.zh: : 只在做家教的时候,好吗?现在,告诉我——昨晚的阅读里,你还发现了什么有趣的地方?

lines.en: : Mostly just the progression of Holden’s feelings concerning simple matters like “youth” and “happiness” over time.
lines.zh: : 主要是 Holden 对「青春」和「幸福」这类简单事物的心境,随时间的推移。

lines.en: : It’s really easy for stories that focus on “coming of age” to come across as preachy and inauthentic but, despite how unbearable he was at times, Holden felt like a very realistic depiction of a teenager.
lines.zh: : 聚焦「成长」的故事很容易显得说教、失真;但尽管他有时让人难以忍受,Holden 的形象却像一个极其写实的青少年。

lines.en: : Jeeves? Is your brain exploding again?
lines.zh: : Jeeves?你的脑子又炸了吗?

lines.en: : Huh?
: You just...
lines.zh: : 你只是……

lines.en: : You reminded me of someone else just now.
lines.zh: : 你刚才让我想起了另一个人。

lines.en: : Nee-sama, perhaps? It was Mother who originally taught us literary analysis, so it’s quite possible my read on this book would echo that of my sister’s.
lines.zh: : Nee-sama?毕竟最早教我们文学分析的,是妈妈。所以我对这本书的解读,很有可能与姐姐的如出一辙。

lines.en: : I haven’t talked about this book with your sister. And I had no idea you were even going to read it.
lines.zh: : 我没有和你姐姐聊过这本书。而我甚至不知道你打算去读它。

lines.en: : I had no idea we were going to talk about it. I was just bored.
lines.zh: : 我也不知道我们会聊到它。我只是无聊。

lines.en: : But now that I know what you’re interested in, you can teach me all sorts of things and we can both have fun! Right, Jeeves?!
lines.zh: : 但现在我知道了你的兴趣所在,你就可以教我各种东西,我们都能玩得开心!对吧,Jeeves?!

lines.en: : It’s “Sensei” while we’re here, Tsukasa.
lines.zh: : 在这里要叫「Sensei」,Tsukasa。

lines.en: And so the two of us remain on that bed.
lines.zh: : 于是,我们俩继续留在那张床上。

lines.en: UNTIL HER SMILE STARTS TO HAUNT ME AND OUR KNEECAPS TOUCH.
lines.zh: : UNTIL HER SMILE STARTS TO HAUNT ME AND OUR KNEECAPS TOUCH.

lines.en: Something tells me I could fit a ring around her ankles and take back something I have lost with age.
lines.zh: : 有什么在告诉我:我可以在她的脚踝上套一个环,夺回某样随岁月流失的东西。
